facts.text: SO/ Paris is at 10 Rue Agrippa d'Aubigné in the 4th arrondissement, between Bastille and Le Marais.
facts.excerpt: SO/ Paris, located at 10 Rue Agrippa d’Aubigné, 75004 Paris, between Bastille and Le Marais

facts.text: The hotel is 2 minutes from Sully-Morland metro station on line 7.
facts.excerpt: Just 2 min from Sully-Morland metro (line 7)

facts.text: The hotel offers prime access to landmarks like Notre-Dame and Place de la Bastille.
facts.excerpt: offers prime access to landmarks like Notre-Dame and Place de la Bastille

facts.text: Room and suite categories are designed to frame views of the Eiffel Tower from above.
facts.excerpt: At SO/ Paris, experience the Eiffel Tower from above. Discover our room and suite categories designed to frame Paris at its most iconic.

facts.text: The architectural firm RDAI, represented by Denis Montel, designed the interior spaces.
facts.excerpt: The architectural firm RDAI, represented by Denis Montel, was the mastermind behind the interior spaces.

facts.text: The Seeing City, an artwork by Studio Other Spaces, Olafur Eliasson and Sebastian Behmann, transformed the bay windows of the restaurant and bar facades on the 15th and 16th floors.
facts.excerpt: The Seeing City, a large-scale artwork installation conceived by Studio Other Spaces, Olafur Eliasson and Sebastian Behmann, has transformed the bay windows of the restaurant and bar facades, situated on the 15th and 16th floors

facts.text: Staff uniforms are designed by Guillaume Henry, artistic director of the Patou fashion house.
facts.excerpt: Dressing the hotel staff is Guillaume Henry, a rising star in the couture world and the artistic director of the Patou fashion house.

facts.text: Artist Thomas Fougeirol created 113 unique photograms and five photomontages for the bedrooms and suites, inspired by his strolls along the Seine.
facts.excerpt: SO/ Paris has commissioned artist Thomas Fougeirol to create a group of 113 unique photograms and five photomontages for the bedrooms and suites. These are inspired by his strolls along the Seine

facts.text: Judith Darmont's REFLECTIONS OF LOVE installation is an immersive digital journey that begins in the lobby and leads to the guest's room.
facts.excerpt: The “REFLECTIONS OF LOVE” installation is an immersive digital journey by Judith Darmont that begins in the lobby, guides you to the elevator and then to your room.

facts.text: French-Algerian artist Neïl Beloufa created a circular resin work for the lobby whose appearance changes with the observer's vantage point and the light.
facts.excerpt: The French-Algerian artist has created a circular resin masterpiece whose appearance varies depending on the observer’s vantage point and the lobby’s evolving light throughout the day

facts.text: Bonnie Restaurant, a French brasserie on the 16th floor, has a panoramic terrace and is open from morning to night.
facts.excerpt: Admire one of the most beautiful views of Paris from the panoramic terrace of Bonnie Restaurant, a creative French brasserie open from morning to night.

facts.text: Bonnie's glass-roofed club sits above the Seine and hosts sets by DJs.
facts.excerpt: At Bonnie’s glass-roofed club above the Seine, dance under the stars to sets by top DJs.

facts.text: Spa Maison CODAGE is run in partnership with CODAGE Paris, a French brand for natural treatments.
facts.excerpt: Guests are invited to rest and recharge in Spa Maison CODAGE, in partnership with CODAGE Paris, the top French brand for natural treatments.

facts.text: The fitness room is open 24/7.
facts.excerpt: Our Fitness Room is open 24/7.

facts.text: Rooms and suites are spread between the 8th and 14th floors and are categorized by the views they offer.
facts.excerpt: rooms and suites are spread out between the 8th and 14th floors and are categorized by the views they offer

facts.text: Rooms have Codage beauty products in the en suite bathroom.
facts.excerpt: Codage beauty products can be found in the en suite bathroom

facts.text: Rooms feature a spirits cabinet, a bulldog-shaped Bluetooth speaker and a minibar stocked with locally sourced snacks.
facts.excerpt: a spirits cabinet, a Bluetooth speaker in the shape of a bulldog and a minibar stocked with locally-sourced snacks

facts.text: The lobby has terrazzo flooring with marble inserts and mushroom-shaped pillars.
facts.excerpt: The terrazzo flooring with marble inserts, soaring volumes, and striking mushroom-shaped pillars make the first big impression

facts.text: The neighbourhood, nicknamed L'Arsenal, was once an island, the Île Louviers.
facts.excerpt: Nicknamed L’Arsenal today, the area used to be an island, much like nearby Île de la Cité and the Ile Saint Louis. The Île Louviers, as it was known in the 18th century

facts.text: A thematic pop-up corner near the elevators is handed over to a rotating roster of artists, floral studios and brands throughout the year.
facts.excerpt: the hotel hands over the space to a rotating roster of artists, floral studios, and brands throughout the year

facts.text: The Codage spa is on the lower level of the building and has few treatment rooms.
facts.excerpt: There aren’t many treatment rooms so make your request when you check-in.

facts.text: A handful of rooms can accommodate children.
facts.excerpt: this isn’t the ideal spot to book as a family but a handful of rooms can accommodate children

facts.text: Animals are permitted.
facts.excerpt: All ADA standards are met and animals are permitted.

facts.text: Bonnie Restaurant offers one of the most beautiful views of Paris.
facts.excerpt: Admire one of the most beautiful views of Paris
